results.title: Elena Quinteros
results.overview: The story of Elena Quinteros, a teacher and political activist who was detained in 1976 during the Uruguayan dictatorship.

results.title: Station to Station
results.overview: Alex is a shy, antisocial young man who finds a refuge from his daily routine at the subway. During his wanderings, he meets Sofia, a woman who seems to see the world differently than he does. This unexpected encounter leads him to question the way he relates to himself and to others.

results.title: Kafka of Kreuzberg
results.overview: Lisa witnesses a mysterious man leave an envelope on a bridge, soon picked up by a woman. The next day the story repeats, but the woman doesn't show. Instead Lisa takes the envelope and embarks on a Kafkaesque quest between time and space.

results.title: Dualidad
results.overview: Uruguayan rapper and singer FUSA searches to reach balance between his two loves in life.

results.title: Body Count (2D)
results.overview: Paul, a Filipino nurse, hooks up with David, an Israeli soldier. They meet and have sex, sharing intimacies that reveal opposing histories of violence. The encounter, recorded in a Berlin apartment, documents the precarity of seeking safety in a world where brutality is ordinary.

results.title: I'll Be Late For My Funeral
results.original_title: I'll Be Late For My Funeral
results.overview: In a small Pacific Northwest town, a bullied teen confides in a cemetery to cope with his isolation. When a violent attack leaves him for dead among the graves, the restless spirits beneath the earth awaken and claim him as their vessel for vengeance.

results.title: The Worst Week of my Life
results.original_title: The Worst Week of my Life
results.overview: After seemingly ordinary night of recreational drug use triggers a prolonged episode of derealization, Jordan's perception of reality unravels. Familiar places, loved ones, and even his own mind become frighteningly alien.

results.title: Hard Feelings
results.overview: What begins as an intimate date at her home quickly takes a bizarre and increasingly dangerous turn when she discovers that Brian isn’t exactly the man she thought she invited over. As the night spirals into a strange mix of romance, dark comedy, and horror, Jane is forced to confront the unsettling truth about her date — and figure out just how far she’s willing to go to survive a night of hard feelings.

results.title: Mister pot Pie
results.overview: In the wake of a bizarre tragedy, a disillusioned corporate wannabe spirals into a delusional obsession that threatens to destroy his marriage and sanity.

results.title: Podcast Abu Nimer & Abu Khanjar
results.overview: A podcast with Abu Nimr, featuring a guest appearance by the king of Iraqi comedy, the comedian Abu Khanjar.

results.title: SHADOWS OF A NATION
results.overview: SHADOWS OF A NATION is a short documentary that explores and observes the daily Brazilian life – an intimate interview with director Akinola Davies Jr, who becomes our narrator and guide in this story – a voice that emerges from the shadows while the story explores heritage, culture, family and sacrifice.  Similarly to the director's own feature film, the journey follows in the footsteps of a people – now Brazilian – starting in the north, leaving behind your culture and customs, in search of a livelihood in the south, the promised land.

results.title: dreamachine
results.overview: dreamachine emerged from the collaboration between sound artist Estelle Schorpp and video artist charline dally. Created from archival footage recorded on DV cassettes in the Shinkansen and Hong Kong trains, the film brings together images that become fluid, blending with analog video feedback and shimmering textures. Musically, synthesized sounds and field recordings, modulated by algorithmic processes, compose a hybrid soundscape with brilliant and enveloping textures. The project seeks to transpose the sensation of looking out of a train window, and the way in which the mind can escape and float away in a dreamlike state.
